_notes.speech: 2026-10-21: talking-to-camera shots keep their audio. Pauses are quiet stretches >= min_pause s in the 300-3400 Hz voice band, below floor + pause_frac*(voice - floor) of that clip (floor = 10th, voice = 95th percentile of 20 ms loudness). Tuned 2026-10-21 on 5 real talking lines (43s, incl. a rainy street clip whose noise never fell below -30 dB) by re-transcribing the tightened audio: 0.45/0.06/0.25 lost no words and cut 43.4s to ~38.6s; the earlier 0.3/0.12/0.3 lost 14 words. pad s of air is left on each side of a cut. Line pauses are judged against the line's own loudness, since a shout elsewhere in a long clip made quiet narration read as silence. A sound under min_sound s (a breath, a click) doesn't break a pause; pieces under min_keep s are dropped.
_notes.captions: 2026-10-30: from the creator's posted Sephora reel (CapCut auto captions, 'page by page short sentence' template): one line of ~2-4 words at a time, no punctuation, TikTok Display Medium size 11 x 0.589 at 63% down; title in Scholar Italic 17.6 x 0.52 at 21% down for the first 3s. CapCut text px = size x scale x width / 170, measured against her frames (captions 80-83 px, title 118 px at 2160 wide). 2026-10-30, her answers: all lowercase (names too, except I); centred 54% down instead of 63%, since she raises the laptop to ~56% and white captions vanished on its screen; title stays up for the whole opening line.
